headline: Citi cuts Micron stock target, sees memory chip prices peaking in 2Q27
summary: Investing.com - Citi slashed its price target on Micron Technology to $1,150 from $1,400 while keeping a Buy rating, citing a more tempered outlook for DRAM and NAND pricing heading into next year.

headline: Copper Market Crunch Brews as US and China Compete for Metal
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The copper market is tightening fast, with a surge in shipments to the US and rising orders in China setting the stage for a rally that could take global benchmark prices to all-time highs.
